historical_rule_preserved: v1 historical mapping/backfill restrictions remain unchanged; v2 adds a stronger contemporaneous prospective event-assignment gate only.
purpose: Deterministically map PRE race-card rider identities to official KEIRIN.JP registration numbers, and require same-event official profile corroboration before a 2026-09-03 race can enter prospective rider-specific affinity evaluation.
normalization_v1: collapse internal ASCII/full-width whitespace to one separator
profile_validation: registration_number must be exactly six decimal digits
official_profile_url query snum must equal registration_number
official profile name must be non-empty
if current_event exists it must contain valid race_date, venue, and positive race_no
resolution_order: one candidate with current_event mismatch on race_date/venue/race_no => FAIL_CLOSED_EVENT_CONTRADICTION
one candidate with exact same-event corroboration => EXACT_SINGLE_MATCH_EVENT_CORROBORATED
one candidate without captured event assignment => EXACT_SINGLE_MATCH_PROFILE_ONLY, which is mapping evidence but does not pass the stronger prospective rider-affinity race gate
prospective_race_identity_gate: PASS only when every PRE rider in the race is EXACT_SINGLE_MATCH_EVENT_CORROBORATED. Any profile-only, unmatched, duplicate-name, contradiction, or uncertainty makes the race fail closed for rider-specific affinity. The race remains in the frozen transport population with explicit identity failure; it is not silently dropped or repaired after RESULT.
important_mark_field_note: The existing PRE parser field `mark` is an objective tactical-count column and is not the prohibited human forecast mark; the mapper therefore does not reject that field name.
output_and_freeze: emit per-rider mapping status and provenance
hash the complete mapping table deterministically
freeze mapping hash before any rider-specific RESULT extraction
do not encode unmapped riders as zero/average/anonymous reusable buckets
